placements.rationale: Extremely fast spherical shot/handgun powder sitting at the fastest end of the pistol band near Bullseye/W231/HP-38-class charts split on exact rank.
Extremely fast flake shotshell/fast-pistol powder placed beside Red Dot/American Select, essentially co-located with S121 at the very fast end.
Fast flake pistol/shotshell powder one step slower than S121/MS200, sitting in the Unique/Blue Dot/Herco band.
Medium spherical revolver/pistol powder in the HS-6/Longshot/Blue Dot band, slower than the fast pistol powders and faster than magnum-revolver powders.
Magnum-revolver powder squarely in the standard H110/W296/2400 magnum-handgun class, the slowest of the handgun powders.
Fast rifle ball powder mapped to AA2230/Benchmark/H335/BLC-2 class per Somchem's own table; the stray S321-equals-H4198 claim is too fast and is a known chart error.
Medium extruded rifle powder equal to IMR3031/AA2460/N133 per Hunting Africa table; sits just faster than Varget and is NOT the Varget powder (common S335/S355 confusion).
Medium ball rifle powder in the IMR4895/BLC-2/Varget band; slower than S335 per Somchem's fast-to-slow order, the .308/.30-06 workhorse grade.
The classic community Varget/RL15 equivalent (AR2208), one notch slower than S335; H4350 is a touch too slow for it.
Slow rifle ball powder triangulated between S355 and S365, on the fast edge of the H4350 band (spherical sibling of S365, just faster).
Flagship slow extruded rifle powder equal to IMR4350/H4350/AR2209 per Somchem and Hunting Africa; NOT H4831/RL22 which is S385 territory.
Slowest Somchem powder, equal to IMR4831/H4831/RL22/Norma MRP by burn rate; used in place of H1000/Retumbo locally though technically a hair faster than those.
